方式: 内置图像生成工具；使用用户提供人物照片
用途: 王立新徽章高清肖像贴图
提示词说明: 保留人物黑发、眼神、白衣与低头抬眼姿态，薄银边圆形徽章，透明背景，无文字，不改成像素画。
初次提示词原文:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: one finished high-resolution Minecraft inventory texture for a portrait pin badge, square 1024 x 1024 PNG with true transparent background.
Input image 1 is the user's supplied portrait of Wang Lixin and is the identity and photographic-content reference. Make a clean circular portrait badge from this exact portrait. Preserve the person's recognizable facial features, downward head angle, upward gaze, thick black fringe partly covering the forehead, expression and white shirt faithfully. Preserve natural photographic detail, including strands of black hair and eyes. Do not beautify, invent a different face, cartoonize, turn into pixel art or smooth away details.
Composition: a single flat, straight-on round pin badge, centered, occupying about 94% of the square. A very thin subtle silver metal rim, about 2% of badge diameter, surrounds the portrait. The portrait fills the badge interior; keep both eyes, nose and mouth fully visible and include the hair silhouette and enough white shirt at the bottom. The beige background visible inside the portrait can stay subdued, but there is absolutely no scene or background outside the round badge. No perspective tilt, no hand holding it, no ribbon, no pedestal, no text, no letters, no watermark, no external cast shadow. Crisp, high-resolution photographic face and hair, clean circular alpha edge. Intended final asset rather than a product mockup.
画布调整提示词原文: Use case: precise-object-edit. This image is the finished Wang Lixin portrait badge for a Minecraft texture. Change only the canvas and exact dimensions: deliver a full uncropped 2048 x 2048 pixel square RGBA PNG with actual transparency outside the circular badge. The dimensions MUST be a power of two (2048 pixels each edge) for Minecraft mipmaps. Keep the existing photographic person, facial identity, eyes, expression, downward head angle, black hair, white shirt, beige inner background and thin silver rim visually unchanged. Fit the complete badge within a circle about 1840 pixels in diameter, centered, leaving at least 100 pixels of fully transparent padding on all four sides. Do NOT trim/crop the transparent padding from the final canvas. No new text, no watermark, no additional objects. Crisp photographic detail, no pixel-art conversion. Return the finished texture itself.
实际输出: 内置工具两次均返回1254×1254；第二版保存为高清母稿。使用macOS sips仅做1024×1024尺寸规范化，未用脚本绘制或修改人物。
参考边界: 原始照片不复制进仓库或Jar；正式贴图为用户指定的人物照片衍生徽章，不能描述为未读取照片的纯文字原创。
